Arthur Whitehead after running with George to over 35 miles faded badly but managed to complete the course to make up our Team, which did very well to close in in such an exacting race at the first attempt.

At 4½ miles Denis Brickwood was nicely placed 29th and running strongly but steadily. Arthur Whitehead, Jock McDonald and Bill Wortley were close behind, while the rest of our lads were among the 100s.

Bedford and Walker then made sure of our victory though Charlie took things a little too easy in the middle and so we missed the course record by one second. Burr ran well on the last leg for the "B" team whilst Rolls, Whitehead and Herbert brought the Vets safely home for their prizes.

His winning 28:34 moved him to no. 3 on the '95 UK list behind our own Paul Evans (28:13) and Skyrac's Whitehead (28:23) but there is more to come, for he had not eased up at all on his training programme prior to the race and had then "sat in" until cutting loose over the final kilometre.
Commonweath Games 10,000m Champion Lameck Aguta joined Gary and and Skyrac's Whitehead as Ian Cornford of Shaftesbury forced the early pace.
